newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Davids slips after announcing write-down.
newsitem.headline: Davids slips after announcing write-down.

text.p: Shares in grocery wholesaler and retailer Davids Ltd slipped 11 cents to A$1.00 in early afternoon trade after the announcement of a major abnormal write-down and other changes.
"The shares are looking very weak and looking like they could go further," said a Sydney broker.
Davids earlier announced a A$262.4 million abnormal writedown, the resignation of John David as executive chairman and forecast a lower than expected profit for 1996/97.
The company also said it would not pay a final dividend and had ended discussions on a merger of its John Lewis food service unit with PFD Food Services.
Davids, which has been under pressure following difficulties amalgamating acqusitions and increasing competition, has seen its shares fall from a closing high of A$1.96 in April last year.
